title: Prompt Injection
summary: Direct and indirect injection, how it differs from jailbreaking, why delimiters, rules and classifiers cannot fix it, adaptive attacks, and the architectures that limit a fooled model: design patterns, dual LLM, CaMeL and the Agents Rule of Two.
